description: Kansas unemployment insurance provides temporary benefits to eligible workers. Apply and submit separate weekly certifications through KansasUI.gov.
introduction: Kansas unemployment insurance provides temporary benefits to eligible workers. Apply and submit separate weekly certifications through KansasUI.gov.

sections.who: KDOL checks covered wages, the employment-separation reason and weekly ability and availability for work. Reduced hours may qualify. Quitting or discharge requires review rather than an automatic assumption.
sections.get: The agency determines the weekly and maximum benefit from wages and the claim. A benefits card by itself does not establish eligibility.
sections.docs: Keep employer details, employment dates, pay records and separation information ready. Record work-search activities and any gross wages or other payments for weekly certification.
sections.apply:
1. Create an account at KansasUI.gov and submit the initial claim. Follow identity and evidence requests.

  2. Continue weekly certifications while unemployed, including the waiting week and while a decision is pending. Complete required work-search activities unless exempt and report earnings accurately.
sections.after: Read the approval or denial notice. If weekly filing fails, contact KDOL immediately; its current handbook lists 800-292-6333. Use the decision’s reconsideration or appeal instructions.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: Eligibility and waiting week, Benefit and filing FAQs, Current claimant handbook.

faqs: Does the waiting week require certification?
Yes. KDOL says certification is needed for it to count.
Potentially; KDOL reviews wages and weekly circumstances.
Should I stop weekly claims while awaiting a decision?
KDOL directs claimants to continue weekly certifications while unemployed.
Does receiving a card mean I was approved?
No. Check the eligibility decision and claim status.
